default_host.description: The default hostname to resolve if no host is specified in the command line arguments.

doh_endpoint.description: The URI of the DNS-over-HTTPS server endpoint to send queries to.

fallback_resolvers.description: A list of IP addresses to use as fallback resolvers if the primary endpoint is unreachable.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to output detailed debugging information about the DNS queries and responses.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for a DNS response before aborting the query.

ca_bundle.description: Path to a custom Certificate Authority (CA) bundle file for TLS validation. Empty string uses system defaults.

tls_version.description: Specific TLS version to enforce (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3). Empty string allows automatic negotiation.
